<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Unreleased</span><code>$intake-linear-work</code></p>

Capture issue, pull-request, review, CI, and project work in Linear while preserving remote-source provenance and explicit write authorization. Use when `.local/arcantry.json` selects Linear as the operational source or when the user explicitly asks to create or update Linear operational state.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link intake-linear-work
```

## Examples

### Capture a remote ticket in Linear

**Prompt**

> Use $intake-linear-work to clone this remote ticket into the configured Linear project after I approve the Linear issue creation.

**Expected outcome**

A concise Linear issue with exact source identity, freshness, scope, and acceptance criteria.

### Prepare a progress update

**Prompt**

> Use $intake-linear-work to draft a progress comment for this issue, but do not publish it until I authorize that exact comment.

**Expected outcome**

A reader-focused English update with one next action and no local or diagnostic context leakage.
